messages:
Avery (People Ops): Quick Q&A thread: finalization & handback process for the review cycle. Weinalize ratings on May 17 17:00 UTC. Posting the minimal checklist and some FAQ items here. Please flag anything missing by EOD Tue. Link to docs: https://docs.internal/reviews/finalization

Nate (People Ops): TL;DR checklist: 1) Managers confirm recommended ratings by May 15 23:59 UTC. 2) People-ops runs quality checks (consistency, outliers) May 16
M. 3) Final sign-off window May 17 (17:00 UTC). 4) Handback to employees scheduled May 19.

Clara (Eng Mgr): For managers who want to adjust after the quality check, what
oes the process look like? Must changes go through people-ops?

Avery (People Ops): Good question. Edits after quality check require a short justification and people-ops approval. Use the `post-qc-edit` form and tag @people-ops. We
void unilateral edits once QC starts to maintain auditability.

Diego (SWE): Is there an automated diff view so I can see what changed between my initial rating and final? That helps when we do calibration debriefs.

Hannah (Data Analyst): Yes 
audit UI shows a side-by-side diff of rating + rationale, plus a `reason` field if post-QC changes happened. We keep an immutable log for compliance.

hr-bot: Reminder: `manager-confirmation` deadline in 72h.

Avery (People Ops): Confidentiality reminder: do not share draft ratings outside the review tool. If you need to discuss a case with another manager, request a private calibration room via the sheet.

Clara (Eng Mgr): For calibration, are samples anonymized to reviewers to reduce halo effects? Last time someone recognized the project and it skewed discussion.

Nate (People Ops): We anonymize names in the calibration packet by default. You will see role, summary, and selected evidence snippets, but names and manager identifiers are redacted. If the calibration lead needs identity unredacted for specific cases, they'll flag it and request exception.

Diego (SWE): Workflow nit: when handback goes out, is it manager-led conversation first or auto-email from hr? Some teams prefer manager conversation before the official note.

Avery (People Ops): Two options supported (pick per-team in the sheet): "manager-first" (manager schedules handback meeting before automated email) or "auto-send" (email goes out then manager follows up within 48h). Set preference in the "handoff-policy" column.

Hannah (Data Analyst): Metrics note: people-ops will compute distribution stats (mean, std, quartiles) per ladder and per org slice post-QC. Expect a summary deck by May 18 12:00 UTC.

Clara (Eng Mgr): What about appeals? If an employee disagrees after handback, what's the window and who reviews it?

Nate (People Ops): Appeals window is 10 business days after handback. Appeals go to an independent review panel (senior manager + people-ops rep). We accept new evidence but not reevaluation purely for score-shifting; appeals focus on process errors or missed context.

hr-bot: Note: `forms-lock` in 36h.

Avery (People Ops): Quick sample calendar blurb managers can use for handback meetings:

`Subject: Performance review handback for [Name]
Time: [Date/time]
Agenda: 1) Highlights & areas for growth (15m) 2) Compensation/next steps (10m) 3) Questions (5m)
Notes: Keep notes brief and use the review tool for final comments.`

Diego (SWE): Who owns publishing calibration notes after the run? I
 like the debrief summary to include examples and rubric clarifications.

Avery (People Ops): People-ops owns the calibration-summary doc. Calibration leads should submit a short writeup within 24h of their session and we will consolidate and push to the review materials repo.

Clara (Eng Mgr): One last ask: can people-ops run a quick anomaly scan for managers with high variance across direct reports? Prefer to catch outlier rating patterns before finalization.

Hannah (Data Analyst): Yup. I'll run a variance check and flag any managers beyond 2.5 std devs from peer group. We'll show the flagged list to people-ops and managers for context-check.

Avery (People Ops): Thanks team. Action items: managers confirm ratings by May 15; set team handback preference in the sheet; calibration leads submit notes within 24h; people-ops will publish final materials May 18. DM @people-ops for exceptions. :white_check_mark:
